content: Python threads release the GIL during I/O and inside C-extension calls that explicitly release it (Py_BEGIN_ALLOW_THREADS). Threading suits I/O-bound work (serial TX, socket writes); CPU-bound work (compression, decode) benefits from multiprocessing where each process gets its own interpreter/GIL, or from C-extension code (zstd, lz4, numpy) that releases the GIL internally so a thread pool still parallelizes across the 4 Cortex-A72 cores.
